texts.zh:
对笼罩[From.GetName]地表的巨大金属晶体的研究结果让所有人大吃一惊，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]十分兴奋的告诉我们说这些巨大的晶体其实是数万亿个已经失去行动机能的纳米机器人！

这些纳米机器人的分子结构不属于任何已知帝国的纳米科技，因此无法确定这些纳米机器人的起源。可能是某种未知舰船出于不明原因而将这些纳米机器人散布于这个行星之上的。

[Root.GetLeaderName]认为这些纳米机器人将自身改造为完美的晶体格子形状并进行自我复制，直到最后失去机能为止。虽然它们创造的晶体类似于建筑，但其在构成上却是完全一样的，因此无法作为建筑使用。
texts.en:
Detailed analysis of the enormous metallic crystals dominating [From.GetName]'s landscape have defied all expectations. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is excited to reveal that these oversized crystals are in fact composed of trillions upon trillions of deactivated nanites!

Their molecular structure matches no known empire's nanotechnology signatures, making their point of origin indeterminable. They may have been deposited on the planet by some unknown spacefarers for an unknown purpose.

As far as [Root.GetLeaderName] can tell, the nanites compiled themselves into perfectly oriented crystalline lattices and replicated until a point at which they became deactivated. While the crystals they created do in fact resemble buildings, they are entirely uniform in composition, and cannot possibly have served any such purpose.

没有任何证据表明[From.GetName]上面曾经有过可以支持生命活动的大气层，因此可能是某种未知舰船出于不明原因而将这些纳米机器人散布于这个行星之上的。

texts.en:
Detailed analysis of the enormous metallic crystals dominating [From.GetName]'s landscape have defied all expectations. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is excited to reveal that these oversized crystals are in fact composed of trillions upon trillions of deactivated nanites!

There is no evidence of [From.GetName] having had an atmosphere thick enough to support life as we know it at any point in the past. The nanites may have been deposited on the planet by some unknown spacefarers for an unknown purpose.

As far as [Root.GetLeaderName] can tell, the nanites compiled themselves into perfectly oriented crystalline lattices and replicated until a point at which they became deactivated. While the crystals they created do in fact resemble buildings, they are entirely uniform in composition, and cannot possibly have served any such purpose.

summary.text:
# 金属晶体结构 / Metallic Crystal Formations

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:944-968; events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:10152 (distar.275)

## 如何开始 How it starts

需要《遥远繁星》。冷荒芜或冰冻星球可能生成（2级，权重1，每个帝国一次）。

Requires Distant Stars. Can spawn on cold barren or frozen planets (level 2, weight 1, once per empire).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

distar.275“纳米机器人晶体格子”：形似摩天楼的巨大晶体由无数失活的纳米机器人组成，来源不明。奖励工程学研究和200纳米机器人。若帝国正在进行“L星团”事件链（l_cluster_chain，需《遥远繁星》），结果增加一条线索（共需7条）；集齐时触发 distar.10904“L星门见解汇集”（另一故事）。30天后的通用接触报告 story.5 是共享事件，不属于本故事。

distar.275 "Nanite Crystal Lattices": the skyscraper-like crystals are trillions of deactivated nanites of unknown origin. Rewards engineering research and 200 nanites. If the empire is running the L-Cluster event chain (l_cluster_chain, Distant Stars), the result adds one clue (7 needed); completing the count fires distar.10904 "L-Gate Insights Gathered" (a separate story). The generic contact report story.5 30 days later is a shared helper, not part of this story.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一结果，无随机分支。

Single outcome; no random branch.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

正文按帝国是否已有通讯对象分两种（有：对比已知帝国的纳米技术；无：说明星球从未有过大气）。排外帝国只有“令人不安”选项：多得社会学研究，但没有纳米机器人。

Two texts depending on whether the empire has any communications (compares with known empires' nanotech / notes the planet never had an atmosphere). Xenophobes only get "Disconcerting": extra society research but no nanites.

Checked the anomaly definition and distar.275.
